title: Phase 3 Testing Task - Video Recording Challenge
description: Test the new Phase 3 functionality by recording a 1-minute video demonstrating a simple daily activity. This task is specifically designed to test the task status handling, submission viewing, and recording capabilities implemented in Phase 3.

requirements: Video must be exactly 1 minute long
Demonstrate a simple daily activity (e.g., making coffee, organizing desk, morning routine)
Show the activity from start to finish
instructions: Choose a simple daily activity you do regularly
Set up your camera in a good position
Record the activity from beginning to end
Ensure good lighting and clear audio
